title: REPORT on the deliberations of the Committee on Petitions in 2023
part_text: 11. Condemns the attempted ‘escraches’ (public shaming through doorstep demonstrations), violence and intimidation by separatist entities and groups, while recognising that the peaceful defence of minority languages and cultures, such as Catalan, must be fully respected in accordance with the principles of pluralism, cultural diversity and human rights as enshrined in the EU Treaties;
